strings.name: Kehinde Wiley
strings.role: Painter · Portrait and public sculpture artist
strings.summary: Wiley places contemporary Black and other people of color in poses and decorative settings drawn from European portrait traditions, redistributing dignity and power within the image. Obama's official portrait broadened his public reach; international projects and a Senegal residency extended his practice. Sexual-assault allegations from 2024, which he denies, led to postponed shows. He presented new work in New York in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Places Black portraiture within traditional painting, using public commissions and international projects to examine power, representation and art history.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: BFA from the San Francisco Art Institute in 1999; MFA from Yale in 2001.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Reworking official portrait traditions
strings.highlights.h1.text: The Obama portrait brings a Black subject and botanical background into the National Portrait Gallery's presidential tradition.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Bodies and monuments
strings.highlights.h2.text: Sculptures including Rumors of War confront historical monuments' language of power with contemporary Black figures.
strings.timeline.t1.title: New portraits opened in New York
strings.timeline.t1.text: What the Light Becomes followed chance street encounters and seasonal change in New York.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Faced a civil sexual-assault suit
strings.timeline.t2.text: Ogechi Chieke sued in New York over an alleged 2007 assault; Wiley denied the allegation and said he did not know her.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Museums changed exhibition plans
strings.timeline.t3.text: Several US institutions postponed or canceled shows after sexual-assault allegations; Wiley denied the claims.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Founded Black Rock Senegal
strings.timeline.t4.text: Established a multidisciplinary residency in Dakar; the public sculpture Rumors of War also appeared that year.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Obama's official portrait unveiled
strings.timeline.t5.text: Entered the Smithsonian National Portrait Gallery, bringing broad public attention to his portrait practice.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Brooklyn career survey held
strings.timeline.t6.text: A New Republic brought together paintings, sculptures and portrait projects from different regions.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Yale MFA and museum residency
strings.timeline.t7.text: After graduating, entered the Studio Museum in Harlem residency, developing contemporary figures within classical painting traditions.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed his BFA
strings.timeline.t8.text: Finished training at the San Francisco Art Institute before graduate study at Yale.
